resources.string: Updates download automatically when internet is available. Installation waits until you are on Home and no alert is active. Android may briefly restart the app or ask for confirmation.
Off. You can check and install manually. A download already in progress can finish; it will not install automatically.
Update ready. Return to Home after the active alert or task is finished.
Allow this app to install updates in Android settings.
Android needs confirmation. Tap to finish the update, or retry from More → Updates.
No newer compatible release is available.
Update not completed. Your installed version is unchanged; we will retry later.
This build uses a shared test signing key. Updates require confirmation. Unattended installation is reserved for privately signed builds.
Update installed. Open the app to check the sensor connection and alerts.
Installation is waiting for an active alert to end. Sensor readings and alerts take priority.
Finish your current task and return to Home to install. Your input will not be closed automatically.
Downloaded and verified. Install now, or close this window to let it install automatically on Home.
Downloaded and verified. Tap Install update when you are ready.
Tap Continue installation to open the Android confirmation. If Play Protect asks for a check, complete it there. The update is not installed yet.
Android is replacing the app. It may close briefly. Reopen Juggluco afterwards to see the new version.
Your installed version is unchanged. Check your internet connection and available storage, then try again.
You can close this window. Downloading does not interrupt sensor readings. Installation is a separate step.
Contacting the release server. The result will appear here automatically.
On. Downloads with internet; installs on Home when no alert is active. Android may ask for confirmation.
